Read in the batch-34 manifest; used in statement and steps 3-5. No stronger structure is taken.

Step 3 of the theorem shows that the logarithmic de Rham complex with pole-count weight filtration W and degree Hodge filtration F, together with the rational comparison, satisfies the definition of a rational cohomological mixed Hodge complex. The definition fixes the shifted cohomology weight filtration W_m H^n(K) = im(H^n(W_{m-n}K) -> H^n(K)) and the purity axiom on the weight-graded complexes, both used verbatim.

Step 5 (functoriality and independence of the compactification) uses strictness for W and F of mixed Hodge morphisms to conclude that the identity comparison map between the mixed Hodge structures attached to two compactifications is an isomorphism of mixed Hodge structures and that the resulting filtrations are independent of choices. The supplier statement gives f(W_nH) = f(H) cap W_nK and f(F^pH_C) = f(H_C) cap F^pK_C together with exactness of Gr^W_n and the pure-image statement; only these clauses are consumed.

Steps 3-4 use part (i) of the supplier: a rational cohomological mixed Hodge complex K yields on every H^n(K_Q) a mixed Hodge structure with the shifted image weight filtration and image Hodge filtration, the weight spectral sequence has E_1^{p,q} = H^{p+q}(Gr^W_{-p}K) pure of weight q and degenerates at E2 with Gr^W_m H^n(K) = E_2^{n-m,m}, and morphisms of mixed Hodge complexes induce morphisms of the resulting structures. The log complex of the theorem is the input; part (ii) (cosimplicial weights at most n) is not used.

Step 3 applies the supplier to the smooth projective complex varieties X and D^[a]: its conclusion gives the Hodge decomposition, the equality of the Hodge filtration with the filtration induced by the holomorphic-degree filtration of the de Rham complex, the E1 degeneration, and the functorial rational pure Hodge structure, which are exactly the purity and E1-degeneracy inputs of the mixed Hodge complex axiom. Hypotheses: characteristic zero, compact Kaehler manifold with its conventions, AC; the compact Kaehler structure of a smooth projective complex variety is the separately recorded open prerequisite. The supplier is a batch-35 scaffold whose authored proof is owed to Steps 3-5.
